name: Halvor
description: A seemingly lazy ash-raker who reveals stubborn courage, slays the trolls, and must journey back to Soria Moria after breaking the princesses’ taboo.
visualPrompt: A young Nordic man with tousled dark hair and an earnest, stubborn expression; first shown in patched, sooty clothes from sitting in an hearth, later glimpsed in princely finery with a simple ring on his finger; sturdy build, travel-worn hands, carrying himself with quiet determination

name: The Youngest Princess
description: The brightest and most devoted of the three sisters, Halvor’s chosen beloved, bound to ring-magic and the strict rule of secrecy.
visualPrompt: A radiant young princess with light, shimmering hair and calm, commanding eyes; dressed in elegant, old-world court garments with subtle magical motifs; poised and affectionate yet capable of decisive action, wearing delicate jewelry that echoes the power of enchanted rings

name: The Many-Headed Troll
description: The monstrous captor of the princesses, reeking out ‘christian man’s blood’ and wielding an enormous sword only strength-magic can lift.
visualPrompt: A towering, hulking troll with rough stone-like skin and multiple snarling heads; each head has different grimacing features and jagged teeth; massive shoulders filling a doorway, clutching an oversized battle-sword, presence oppressive and feral

name: Vestenvinden (The West Wind)
description: A personified wind who knows the road to Soria Moria and carries Halvor across heaths and fjells toward the wedding.
visualPrompt: An elemental, human-like figure formed from swirling air and pale cloud, with hints of a cloak made of gusts; hair streaming like mist, eyes bright as stormlight; leaves, needles, and sea-spray spiraling around him, conveying speed and power

name: The Old Woman of the Forest Hut
description: A strange, ancient helper who questions the moon and bargains for Halvor’s horse in exchange for far-stepping boots.
visualPrompt: A very old, grey-haired woman in a dim woodland hut, thin and sharp-featured with an exaggeratedly long nose; wrapped in worn woolen layers, eyes lively and cunning; holding a pair of battered, magical boots that seem to hum with restless motion
